source_doc: What Are the Different User Experiences in Genuin

entities.name: Community Media Network
entities.description: A brand-owned network spanning strategy, content, technology, governance, and monetization that Genuin enables teams to launch, operate, and scale.

entities.name: Brand Control Center
entities.description: The operating system within Genuin for network setup, management, and performance, used to configure communities, curate content, moderate, and activate monetization.

entities.name: Retail Media Network
entities.description: A commerce-driven Community Media Network experience for retailers hosting multiple brands and advertisers across product and category pages.

entities.name: Genuin SDK
entities.description: Software development kits for Web, iOS, Android, React, and Flutter that enable embedding Genuin community and video experiences into existing platforms.

entities.name: Genuin API
entities.description: API surface that powers personalization, targeting, and data pipelines to analytics and storage systems.

entities.name: Clip It
entities.description: A short-form video creation tool used by creators to publish content within brand-owned communities.

entities.name: Curate
entities.description: A moderation workflow with Activity and Task Timeline views for reviewing content by lifecycle state, approving, rejecting, or moving content.

entities.name: Community Video Feeds
entities.description: Scrollable, immersive, contextual video feeds embedded across product listing, detail, category, and discovery pages.

entities.name: Product Listing Page Placement
entities.description: Placement of community-powered video feeds on retailer Product Listing Pages to influence discovery.

entities.name: Product Detail Page Placement
entities.description: Placement of community-powered video feeds on Product Detail Pages to drive purchase consideration.

entities.name: AI Content Curation
entities.description: AI capability with human-in-the-loop approval used to curate, classify, and moderate content at scale.

entities.name: White-labeled Embeds
entities.description: White-labeled, configurable embeds that let teams place Genuin experiences across web and app environments.

entities.name: Publishers
entities.description: Publishers operating brand-owned Community Media Networks who own distribution, audience relationships, and monetization.

entities.name: Brands and Enterprises
entities.description: Brands and enterprises building owned communities and operating their own presence on Genuin.

entities.name: Retailers
entities.description: Retailers and commerce platforms operating media networks that host multiple brands and advertisers.

entities.name: Creators and Influencers
entities.description: Content creators and influencers contributing content inside trusted brand ecosystems with clear attribution.

entities.name: Moderation Teams
entities.description: Teams responsible for content quality, compliance, and enforcing platform, brand, and community guidelines.

entities.name: Consumers
entities.description: Visitors to publisher or brand websites and apps who engage with scrollable video feeds without leaving the brand ecosystem.

entities.name: Product Managers
entities.description: Product managers responsible for embedding Genuin into existing web and app environments.

entities.name: Engineering Teams
entities.description: Engineering and integration teams that implement Genuin SDKs and APIs across platforms.

entities.name: Growth Marketing Teams
entities.description: Cross-functional teams within publishers and brands responsible for community growth, marketing, revenue, and operations.

entities.name: Sponsorships
entities.description: Brand sponsorship activations enabled through the Brand Control Center as part of monetization.

entities.name: Commerce Activation
entities.description: Commerce-driven engagement including shoppable and actionable calls to action that convert engagement into measurable outcomes.

entities.name: Advertising Activation
entities.description: Brand-safe, first-party media revenue activations within owned properties and across retail networks.

entities.name: Brand Safety and Governance
entities.description: Standards and controls that maintain brand safety, editorial quality, and content governance across the network.

entities.name: Customer Lifetime Value
entities.description: Business outcome metric improved by retail and commerce media experiences.

entities.name: Customer Acquisition Cost
entities.description: Business outcome metric reduced through community-driven engagement on retailer properties.

entities.name: Engagement Metrics
entities.description: Metrics tracked across the network including time-on-site, session depth, and conversion lift driven by community trust.

entities.name: Closed-Loop System
entities.description: Genuin's connected loop where brands build, creators contribute, AI curates, product embeds, consumers engage, and data feeds intelligence.

entities.name: Content Ingestion Workflow
entities.description: Workflows for ingesting, curating, and moderating content across the platform.

entities.name: Analytics and Reporting
entities.description: Analytics, reporting, and monetization systems that track engagement, growth, and performance.

entities.name: Genuin Resource Center
entities.description: Documentation hub where each Genuin experience is explored in depth for different roles.

entities.name: Social Account Syncing
entities.description: Feature allowing creators to sync social accounts and upload content into Genuin communities.

entities.name: Communities and Groups
entities.description: Brand-owned communities and groups where content aggregation, engagement, and discovery happen.

entities.name: Personalization Engine
entities.description: API-driven personalization and targeting that enables context-aware experiences across placements.

entities.name: Data Pipelines
entities.description: Data pipelines connecting Genuin to analytics and storage systems.

relationships.description: Brand Control Center is the operating system used to set up, manage, and govern a Community Media Network.

Brand Control Center activates commerce experiences and shoppable calls to action.
Brand Control Center activates advertising and first-party media revenue.

Brand Control Center surfaces analytics, reporting, and monetization performance tracking.

Brands and enterprises build and own communities and groups.
